scene_meta.time: year 17,503 (Three weeks after scene 025.5, following scene 026.4)
scene_meta.focus: Geralt uses speech and Applicator guidance to heal Oreck, grant him vocal speech, and recruit him as a brother-in-arms to claim the Dragon Mail.
scene_meta.continuity: Follows scene 026.4 and three weeks after scene 025.5
scene_meta.cutscene purpose: Establish the brotherhood between Geralt and Oreck and grant Oreck vocal speech.

scene_meta.focus: Geralt and Oreck travel to ancient pre-Anunnaki ruins, bond over shared experiences of slavery and choice, and enter the subterranean temple.
scene_meta.continuity: Follows scene 027.1 on the same day
scene_meta.cutscene purpose: Depict the journey to the ancient ruins and deepen the bond between Geralt and Oreck.

scene_meta.focus: Ušumgallu emerges to test Geralt and Oreck; Geralt cracks one of her divine chains with telekinesis to pass the trial of recognition.
scene_meta.cutscene purpose: Introduce Ušumgallu and pass the trial of recognition.

scene_meta.focus: Ušumgallu subjects Geralt to Ethereal visions of corruption and tyranny, which Geralt overcomes by accepting internal doubt and plural accountability.
scene_meta.cutscene purpose: Test Geralt's moral character against corruption and pass the trial of doubt.

scene_meta.focus: Oreck touches the central sigil, endures binding agony, and shatters the divine nexus; Ušumgallu heals Oreck, removes his Anunnaki obedience conditioning, and ascends in freedom.
scene_meta.cutscene purpose: Shatter Ušumgallu's divine chains, free Oreck from Anunnaki neural conditioning, and grant access to the armor chamber.

scene_meta.focus: Geralt bonds with the Dragon Mail; Zaron, Applicator, and Geralt negotiate a three-consciousness truce as Geralt begins learning to move in the armor.
scene_meta.cutscene purpose: Depict Geralt bonding with the Dragon Mail and establishing the trinity of consciousness (Geralt, Applicator, Zaron).

scene_meta.participants: Geralt, Oreck, Mika, The Five (Jin, Kael, Tess, Vale, Ren), Applicator, Zaron, Freed Slaves
scene_meta.focus: Geralt and Oreck return to the compound; Geralt grants vocal speech to Mika and freed slaves while respecting the Five's refusal of modification, and outlines plans to liberate three nearby Anunnaki camps.
scene_meta.continuity: Hours following scene 027.6 on the same day
scene_meta.cutscene purpose: Establish the compound's unity, grant speech to the populace, respect the Five's boundaries, and launch the campaign to liberate neighboring camps.
